label: Glam rock
core: seventies glam rock, swaggering boogie stomp

grafts.label: Handclaps & stomps
grafts.phrase: big handclaps and foot stomps on the backbeat

grafts.label: Guitares harmonisées
grafts.phrase: multi-tracked harmonized lead guitars like a small orchestra

grafts.label: Guitare à l'envers
grafts.phrase: reversed guitar swells breathing between phrases

grafts.label: Sax baryton rugueux
grafts.phrase: a honking baritone saxophone doubling the riff

far.label: Arpèges 8-bit
far.phrase: low-bit tracker-style arpeggios sparkling over the stomp

far.label: Quatuor de chambre
far.phrase: a close-miked string quartet with rosin and bow noise

far.label: Sub électronique
far.phrase: a deep electronic sub-bass pulse under the band

extra: glitter and swagger in every hit
the riff struts like a catwalk

presets.label: Boogie stomp
presets.note: Riff boogie fuzz, claps, toms qui martèlent, swagger.
detail: a strutting boogie riff on fuzz guitar, handclaps and stomping floor toms, glitter swagger

presets.label: Opéra rock
presets.note: Ouverture piano-ballade, guitares harmonisées, bascule rock soudaine.
detail: a piano ballad opening, layered harmonized lead guitars, a sudden heavy rock section, theatrical shifts of mood

presets.label: Psychedelic
presets.note: Douze-cordes phasées, guitares à l'envers, mellotron, brume.
detail: phased twelve-string guitars, backwards guitar swells, mellotron flutes, a dreamy glam haze

presets.label: Glam néon motorik
presets.note: Riff glam calé sur une pulsation motorik, lead synthé analogique.
detail: a glam stomp riff locked to a relentless motorik pulse, a bright analog synth lead strutting on top
